# Generator for the chart-edit-*.xlsx fixtures (openpyxl): a chart title edit must not rewrite the whole package.
from openpyxl import Workbook, load_workbook
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, LineChart, Reference

def base(extra_first=False):
    wb = Workbook()
    if extra_first:
        ex = wb.active; ex.title = "Extra"
        ex.append(["x", 1, 2]); ex.append(["y", 3, 4])
        c = BarChart(); c.title = "Extra chart"
        c.add_data(Reference(ex, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=2), titles_from_data=False)
        ex.add_chart(c, "E2")
        ws = wb.create_sheet("Data")
    else:
        ws = wb.active; ws.title = "Data"
    ws.append(["m", "rev", "cost", "profit"])
    for i in range(1, 5): ws.append([i, i * 10, i * 7, i * 3])
    c = LineChart(); c.title = "Revenue vs Cost"
    c.add_data(Reference(ws, min_col=2, max_col=3, min_row=1, max_row=5), titles_from_data=True)
    ws.add_chart(c, "F2")
    return wb

def edit(src, dst, fn):
    wb = load_workbook(src); fn(wb["Data"]._charts[0], wb["Data"]); wb.save(dst)

base().save("chart-edit-a.xlsx")
edit("chart-edit-a.xlsx", "chart-edit-roundtrip.xlsx", lambda c, ws: None)
edit("chart-edit-a.xlsx", "chart-edit-title.xlsx", lambda c, ws: setattr(c, "title", "Revenue vs Cost 2026"))
def axis(c, ws): c.x_axis.title = "Month"; c.y_axis.title = "Dollars"
edit("chart-edit-a.xlsx", "chart-edit-axis.xlsx", axis)
def seriesadd(c, ws):
    from openpyxl.chart import Series
    c.series.append(Series(Reference(ws, min_col=4, min_row=2, max_row=5), title="profit"))
edit("chart-edit-a.xlsx", "chart-edit-series-added.xlsx", seriesadd)
edit("chart-edit-a.xlsx", "chart-edit-series-removed.xlsx", lambda c, ws: c.series.pop())
def bar(c, ws):
    b = BarChart(); b.title = c.title; b.series = c.series; ws._charts[0] = b
edit("chart-edit-a.xlsx", "chart-edit-type.xlsx", bar)
edit("chart-edit-a.xlsx", "chart-edit-removed.xlsx", lambda c, ws: ws._charts.clear())
# renumbered parts: another sheet's chart now comes first, so the Data chart is chart2.xml / drawing2.xml
wb = base(extra_first=True); wb["Data"]._charts[0].title = "Revenue vs Cost 2026"; wb.save("chart-edit-renumbered.xlsx")
